facts.rationale: Corrects the obsolete held_inputs field spelling while preserving the directly verified data flow and transition arguments.
facts.value: Resolves the Fighter from gobj and reads u.kb.xE4. Any nonzero value is decremented and ends the update. At zero, it tests input.held_buttons[0] against 0x200; when that bit is clear, it requests ftKb_MS_SpecialNEnd with flags 0, start frame 0.0f, rate 1.0f, blend 0.0f, and NULL as the final argument.
